About Zipline

Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.

Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. ABOUT OBLQ

OBLQ builds software for independent insurance agencies, providing technology solutions that help independent P&Cs operate more efficiently and grow faster. We handle the technology so agencies can focus on selling policies and driving revenue. Learn more at oblq.ai.

Same Team. More Agency.

THE ROLE

We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager to help turn our products that deliver for existing customers into a company and category that independent insurance agencies know about, understand, and want to buy.

You'll work directly with the founders and stay close to both the product and our customers. You'll learn how independent agencies operate, what slows their teams down, why they buy, what makes them skeptical, and how OBLQ changes the economics of their business. Then you'll turn those insights into the way we go to market.

You'll own product positioning, messaging, launches, customer stories, sales enablement, competitive intelligence, and much of the content that connects OBLQ to the market.

This is an early-stage role. We have products our customers love, we have great data and measurable results, a brand, and a point of view. We need someone who can take those raw materials and build a repeatable product marketing engine around them.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Position OBLQ and its products.
Develop clear positioning and messaging for OBLQs current and future products. Understand what matters to agency owners & agents, and translate complex product capabilities into simple reasons to care.

Own the product story.
Make sure our website, social presence, sales materials, demos, campaigns, and product launches tell a consistent and compelling story.

Know the customer.
Spend time with independent agency owners and agents. Understand how they generate leads, quote business, work with carriers, use their CRM, follow up with customers, and make technology decisions.

Turn customer outcomes into proof.
Build case studies, customer stories, ROI narratives, testimonials, and other evidence that helps prospective customers understand what OBLQ can do for their agency.

Build sales enablement.
Give the people selling OBLQ what they need to have better conversations: messaging, presentations, one-pagers, competitive positioning, objection handling, demo narratives, follow-up materials, and customer-specific stories.

Own product launches.
Create the go-to-market plan for new capabilities, carrier integrations, product releases, and future OBLQ products. Define the audience, message, channels, assets, and measures of success.

Understand the market.
Know the insurance technology landscape, the alternatives agencies use today, and where OBLQ fits. Track competitors, comparative raters, agency management systems, CRMs, automation products, and emerging technologies that could change the market.

Build content that earns attention.
Create and manage content for the channels where our customers spend time. That may include LinkedIn, customer email, website content, product education, thought leadership, webinars, industry communities, and other formats we discover work.

Improve how we generate demand.
Work across organic, outbound, partnerships, referrals, and paid acquisition to understand which messages and channels create qualified interest. Test quickly, measure results, and keep what works.

Bring the market back into the product.
You won't own the product roadmap, but you'll have an important voice in it. Bring customer feedback, competitive intelligence, win/loss insights, and market signals back into product decisions.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You have experience marketing B2B software products and can show examples where your work changed how a product was understood, sold, adopted, or launched.

You know how to find the useful insight inside a customer conversation and turn it into positioning or messaging people actually understand.

You can explain a complicated product simply without stripping away what makes it valuable.

You understand the difference between describing a feature and explaining why someone should care about it.

You're comfortable creating the strategy and doing the work. At this stage, you may define the launch plan in the morning and write the landing page in the afternoon.

You can work closely with product and engineering teams and become technically fluent enough to market what we're building accurately.

You use data to evaluate your work. You care about pipeline, conversion, engagement, adoption, and revenue more than impressions for their own sake.

You're comfortable operating with incomplete information and creating structure where it doesn't yet exist.

You have strong judgment about brand and messaging. You know when something needs another round of thinking and when it just needs to get into the market so we can learn.

SKILLS WE'RE INTERESTED IN

Working with AI tools to accelerate research, content, experimentation, and execution
B2B SaaS or vertical SaaS
Insurance or insurtech (nice to have)
Products sold to small and midsize businesses
Workflow automation or operational software
Product-led or founder-led companies moving toward a repeatable GTM model
Sales enablement and customer storytelling
Launching new or unfamiliar product categories
Competitive and market research
Demand generation and lifecycle marketing

Insurance experience is not a prerequisite. We care more about your ability to understand a market quickly and turn what you learn into effective product marketing.

HOW WE WORK

Our development cycle is fast. New capabilities can move from idea to working software quickly, which means product marketing needs to stay equally close to the product and the customer.

We value people who understand the problem, form a point of view, communicate it clearly, put it into the market, measure what happens, and improve it.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

A year from now:
An independent agency owner can land on OBLQ and quickly understand what we do, why it's different, and why it matters to their business.
Our positioning and messaging are consistent everywhere a prospect encounters us.
Customer outcomes have become credible stories, proof points, and sales assets.
Product launches have an audience, message, plan, and measurement strategy before they ship.
Sales conversations are supported by strong materials and a clear understanding of customer objections and competitive alternatives.
We know which messages, audiences, and channels create qualified opportunities and we're investing more heavily in the ones that work.
What we're learning in the market is consistently making its way back into the product.
Our product marketing capability is repeatable and can scale with the company.

About HotDrop

HotDrop is a social platform built for the creator economy. Creators use it to keep their communities together, show their work and connect with each other. Fans use it to stay close to the creators they support.

Every creator gets a Circle, a home for their community that connects to their Twitch and YouTube. Around it, HotDrop gives creators a feed, stories, messaging, and a Site and media kit they can share with brands and collaborators. HotDrop is live on iOS, Android and the web, with Reels and a desktop app coming by the end of the year.

The product is built. What HotDrop needs now is someone who knows how to get creators and their communities to show up, and to keep coming back.

The role

You’ll own HotDrop’s marketing from day one: the strategy, the voice and the hands-on work. This isn’t a role where you hand things off to an agency or a team. You’ll run our social channels yourself, shape how we pitch HotDrop to creators and fans, and lead our launches.

You’ll work directly with the founder and our Head of Creator Growth. They bring creators onto the platform; you make sure those creators’ audiences hear about HotDrop, want to join and have a reason to stay.

What you’ll do

Social and content
Run HotDrop’s social accounts day to day, including X, TikTok, Instagram and YouTube
Turn what’s happening on HotDrop (creators, communities, moments, milestones) into content people want to share
Build a consistent HotDrop voice and look across every channel

Launches
Own our launches, starting with Reels and our desktop app later this year
Line up creators before each launch, seed the content and drive the launch itself
Plan campaigns that bring past users back when there’s something new to see

Creators and their communities
Help creators invite their audiences into their HotDrop Circles: what they say on stream, what they post in their Discord and on social, and when
Write the playbooks and assets that make inviting easy for creators: templates, clips, graphics and talking points
Work with our Head of Creator Growth on our creator programs

Positioning
Sharpen how we explain HotDrop to creators and to fans
Keep our website, emails, app store pages and social posts telling the same story
Shape and promote the HotDrop Twitch show with the founder

Measurement
Track what brings people in and what keeps them coming back
Double down on what works and cut what doesn’t, quickly

What success looks like

More new people arriving each week, and more of them staying. Within your first 90 days, you’ll have:

Taken over HotDrop’s social channels and set a regular posting rhythm
Shipped a creator invite playbook our pilot creators actually use
Led at least one launch from planning through results
Set up a simple weekly view of what’s bringing people in and what’s keeping them

What we’re looking for

You’ve grown an audience or a community yourself, whether a channel, a brand account or a creator’s following, and you can show the results
You know the creator economy from the inside. You understand how streamers, YouTubers, mods and fans think, and what makes a creator promote something to their audience
You’ve done hands-on social and growth work, not just strategy
You write well and fast, and you can make short-form video and graphics or get them made
You’re comfortable building from scratch at an early-stage startup, with a small team and a lot of ownership
You’re self-directed: you’ll set your own priorities week to week and tell us what you need

Nice to have

Experience at a creator platform, a gaming company, a creator agency or an esports organization
Experience on Twitch or in gaming communities
Experience running app launches or growth campaigns for a consumer app
Connections with creators, mods or community managers

How we work

Remote, 10 to 20 hours a week, scheduled around your other commitments
You’ll work directly with the founder, with real say over what we do
We move quickly, ship often and decide based on what we learn

Compensation

This role is paid in equity. There’s no cash salary at this stage, and that’s why we’re looking for someone who wants to own a meaningful piece of what they help build. Equity vests over time, and we’ll share the specifics in our first conversation.

A Little Bit About Us:
You might know us from our founder and CEO, Dave Ramsey, who's given no-nonsense money advice on the radio since 1992. Three decades later, Ramsey Solutions is a household name in personal finance, with a mission to change the toxic money culture for good.

Our Mission: Ramsey Solutions provides biblically based, commonsense education and empowerment that give HOPE to everyone in every walk of life.

Health insurance (includes plans eligible for an HSA—with a company match up to $500!)

On-campus cafe with subsidized pricing for breakfast, lunch and coffee bar

Where And How You'd Work

Ramsey Solutions Headquarters is located just outside of Nashville in Franklin, Tennessee. We value our strong, unified company culture because we believe the best work is done together. That's why all of our team members work on-site under the same roof. But work-life balance is also important to us, so we offer flexible work schedules to take the stress out of appointments, family obligations and other needs that may pop up.

While every team member has a designated workspace (with an electronic sit-stand desk), our campus was designed to house a variety of unique work and play zones (e.g., quiet library space, coffee bar/lounge areas, recreational game zone, and outside/patio work and break areas).

What You'd Do In This Role

Ramsey's investing content reaches millions of people trying to build wealth the right way, and this role owns turning that message into content that stops the scroll. You'll set the strategy, content calendar, and publishing standards across Instagram, Facebook, X, and TikTok, spotting the moments worth turning into a clip and shaping the hooks, formats, and cadence that move people from casual followers to loyal fans of the brand. You'll dig into the numbers, impressions, engagement, and retention, and use what you find to sharpen the strategy in real time. And you'll be a steady hand for the Video Editors you brief, giving them clear direction so the content that goes out consistently sounds and feels like Ramsey.

You're Probably a Match If

You've grown business-focused social accounts and know how to turn content into real audience growth, not just likes.
You think like a strategist, someone who owns the plan, reads the audience, and makes intentional calls, rather than just posting content.
You've got 2+ years of experience building and growing social accounts, with a track record of content that connects with an audience.
You're comfortable in the numbers, digging into platform analytics and turning what you find into a clear next move.
You can talk about money and investing in a way that feels warm, approachable, and easy to follow, never intimidating.
You represent the brand's voice and Ramsey's investing principles clearly and consistently.
You're a self-starter who brings ideas to the table and moves things forward without needing a lot of direction.

What Winning Looks Like

Growing engagement across platforms in a way that reflects a clear, consistent content strategy, not just more posts.
Moving people from casual followers on third-party platforms to loyal fans of Ramsey's owned channels.
Turning platform data into next steps, testing new ideas quickly, and adjusting course based on results.
Building a steady rhythm for sharing insights and recommendations with stakeholders so decisions get made with the numbers in hand.
Staying ahead of platform and industry trends and explaining clearly why they matter for the strategy.
Giving Video Editors clear direction and feedback that makes their work stronger and keeps the content on brand.
Owning the final call on content decisions while staying genuinely open to input along the way.

Other Stuff To Know

We're looking for people who are passionate about our mission. This isn't just a J-O-B. We experience resistance every day because what we believe is absolutely countercultural. We actually hate debt. We actually cut up our credit cards . . . like, for real. Some of us are still fighting our way out of debt, but we aren't going back. If you don't know much about Ramsey Solutions and our founder, Dave Ramsey, we encourage you to download the Ramsey Network mobile app and consume our content.
